d:
Burhiya bhi lag rahi hai jo chanchal si hasina
Jaise ki svarn mudrika men koee nagina
Har or mauj masti hai rangon ka zor hai
Apna to vailentain hai phagun ka mahina...holi par shambhushikhar ki hansi thitholi aap bhi dekhen sirf sahity tak par.
Aap sabhi ko holi ke pavan parv par hardik shubhkamnaen.
